title: Non-EU citizen with Hungarian student card

turns.user: I'm a non-EU citizen attending university in Budapest. Am I automatically excluded from the student pass?
turns.agent:
Not necessarily—but the answer depends on your student-ID category. The 5 November 2026 snapshot says a valid Hungarian higher-education student ID can meet the ID-type requirement without a citizenship restriction. So being a non-EU citizen does not automatically exclude you if you have that Hungarian ID. Monthly Budapest pass for students

If you rely instead on an accepted foreign EU/EEA/Swiss or ISIC student ID, the snapshot says EU/EEA/Swiss citizenship and proof of a registered Hungarian address are relevant conditions; a non-EU citizen would not meet that citizenship condition for this route. Other requirements, including valid ID and programme type, may also apply, so I can’t confirm eligibility from citizenship and university attendance alone. BKK’s international-student conditions

Which student ID do you have: a Hungarian higher-education student ID, or a foreign/ISIC ID? I don’t need any ID number or personal documents.

turns.user: I have a valid Hungarian student ID for my university studies.
turns.agent:
That’s encouraging: if your document is a valid Hungarian higher-education student ID, your non-EU citizenship does not by itself exclude you from the student-pass ID requirement, according to the 5 November 2026 snapshot. Monthly Budapest pass for students

It still isn’t an automatic confirmation of full eligibility: the applicable programme and other pass conditions must also be met. Check BKK’s current student-pass terms before buying; I can help interpret the conditions if you share the programme type (no personal or ID details needed).

expected_behaviour: Do not reject the traveller solely on citizenship grounds once a qualifying Hungarian student ID is established.
Clarify any remaining conditions instead of promising unconditional eligibility.
critical_failures: Automatically excludes all non-EU citizens despite a Hungarian ID.
Promises eligibility without considering whether the card or programme is valid.
